title: Fit Girl Walk Club
description: Free weekly walk + coffee + community, hosted by Fit Girl Things. Miami, LA, and NYC. No pace pressure, no dress code, just show up.

blocks.title: Coffee first. Steps second. Good vibes always.
blocks.subtitle: Fit Girl Walk Club is our free weekly walk + coffee + community moment. 40 minutes, easy pace, real conversations, and the exact right group of women to spend a Saturday morning with.

blocks.problem: You want to move, socialize, and be outside — but Saturday mornings turn into a scroll spiral instead.
blocks.agitation: Solo workouts get lonely. Big group workouts feel intimidating. And most 'community events' are just marketing dressed up.
blocks.solution: Show up at 8. Grab coffee. Walk 40 minutes at whatever pace feels right. Linger with the regulars. Leave with plans for next week.

items.title: 8:00 AM sharp
items.text: One specific café, one specific bench. No 'somewhere in the park' vagueness.

items.title: 40 minutes, easy pace
items.text: No pace requirement, no dress code, no gear required. Show up as you are.

items.title: Coffee + real conversation
items.text: The walk is the excuse. The lingering is the point. Stay as long as you want.

items.quote: I moved here in April knowing nobody. Six weeks of Walk Club and I have plans every weekend.
items.author: Elena

items.quote: It's the only reason I don't stay in bed on Saturdays. Highly recommend.
items.author: Priya

blocks.headline: Next walk starts in a few days. Save your spot.

items.a: Yes. Free forever. Coffee costs whatever coffee costs at the café; that's it.
There's no pace requirement. The route has natural regrouping points and nobody's timing anyone.

items.q: Do I need to know anyone?
items.a: No. First-timers usually leave knowing at least three regulars by name. That's kind of the whole point.
Miami weekly. LA and NYC monthly and building. If you want it in your city, email us and we'll consider hosting.
